entities.name: Michaela Zrůstová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michaela Zrůstová is a Czech female basketball player. At the 2012 Summer Olympics, she competed for the Czech Republic women's national basketball team in the women's event. She is 6 ft 1 inches tall.
